sections.heading: Custom spa gift set packaging and self-care boxes
sections.text: Packaging applications Custom spa gift set packaging and self-care boxes For a spa gift set or sleep kit, plan the packaging around both soft accessories and bottles. A folded pillowcase or sleep mask needs a different recess from a pump bottle: confirm the folded size, cap clearance and how each item will be lifted out. This wellness gift box is a packaging concept; the pictured contents illustrate the layout and are not included in a packaging quotation. Sleep kit packaging Measure textiles in their packed, folded condition. Leave a finger notch or ribbon lift so the buyer can remove a soft item without pulling at the tray. Self-care gift box with insert Provide the bottle and jar dimensions including pumps, lids and any outer cartons. Separate liquids from textiles and review the packed sample for movement and closure clearance. Before ordering custom spa gift boxes Send a product list, actual samples or dimensioned drawings, folded accessory sizes, artwork and order quantity. Specify whether sets will be hand-delivered, sold in-store or shipped individually; a presentation box may need a separate transit carton. sections.heading: Build the presentation around your product
sections.text: Customization Build the presentation around your product Logo & foil Review foil, print, emboss or deboss artwork against the chosen paper. Custom colour Use ivory, black, seasonal colours or a Pantone-matched wrapped paper. Fitted insert Set cavity count, product orientation and clearance from measured samples. Surface finish Compare matte, soft-touch, textured and other finish options at sampling.

sections.heading: What changes the quotation?
sections.text: Quote factors What changes the quotation? Finished dimensions, board and wrap grade, insert material, print coverage, finishing steps, quantity, packed carton dimensions, destination and Incoterms all affect the final scope. Ask for the same assumptions on every supplier quotation.

sections.heading: Buyer questions
sections.text: FAQ Buyer questions Can the insert hold products of different sizes? Yes. The cavity layout can be developed around the measured height, width and depth of each item in the set. Can the box colour and logo be customized? Yes. Wrapped paper colour, artwork, foil, embossing and surface finish are reviewed with the quotation. Can you make a paper-based insert? Paperboard and molded-pulp options can be reviewed alongside EVA when the product protection and finish requirements allow it. What is needed for a quote? Send product dimensions, quantities, destination, artwork and the preferred insert or presentation style.
